results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Single Arm Rear Delt Row
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handle to about chest height. Stand facing the handle, holding one handle with an overhand grip (palm facing down), and lean back slightly with your arm extended and feet shoulder-width apart.
Engage your arm and pull your chest towards the handle by bending your elbow and driving it out to the side, focusing on squeezing your shoulder blade towards your spine.
Continue pulling until your upper arm is parallel to the floor and your elbow is bent at a 90-degree angle.
Slowly extend your arm back to the starting position with control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
tips: Focus on using your rear deltoid and upper back muscles to perform the row, avoiding excessive use of your arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid shrugging them towards your ears.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you pull your chest towards the handle and inhale as you extend your arm back.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Single Arm Rear Delt Row is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Biceps, Forearms.

results.name: Suspension Trainer With Grips Split Fly
instructions: Adjust the suspension trainer handles to about chest height. Stand facing the handles with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a handle in each hand with an overhand grip (palm facing down) with the left hand and an underhand with the right (palm facing up).
Engage your core and lean back slightly with your arm extended, keeping your body straight from head to heels and your arms extended in front of you at shoulder height.
Spread your arms in front of you, bringing your left arm overhead and the right arm by your hip, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Slowly bring your arms back together to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Start with a smaller range of motion and gradually increase as your strength and flexibility improve.
Ensure your wrists are straight and not bending during the movement.
Breathe steadily: exhale as you open your arms and inhale as you bring them back together.
results.description: Suspension Trainer With Grips Split Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with a suspension trainer, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Trap Bar Shrug
instructions: Stand in the center of a trap bar with your feet shoulder-width apart. Bend your knees and hips to lower your body, and grasp the handles of the trap bar with a neutral grip (palms facing in).
Stand up straight with the trap bar at arm's length by your sides, keeping your core engaged and back straight.
Lift your shoulders towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the starting position. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Breathe steadily: exhale as you shrug your shoulders and inhale as you lower them.
Keep your neck relaxed and avoid straining it during the movement.
Ensure your back remains straight and avoid leaning forward or backward.
results.description: Trap Bar Shrug is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the traps (back). Performed with a trap bar, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Forearms.

results.name: 5 Sec Fist Against Chin
instructions: Sit or stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart, maintaining good posture. Make a fist with both hands and place them under your chin.
Apply gentle upward pressure with your fist against your chin, resisting with your neck muscles. Hold this position for 5 seconds.
Keep your neck and head steady, avoiding any movement while maintaining the pressure.
Release the pressure after 5 seconds and relax. Repeat the exercise for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your jaw relaxed, avoiding clenching your teeth.
Focus on the resistance created by your fist and neck muscles rather than the amount of force applied.
Breathe normally throughout the exercise, avoiding holding your breath.
results.description: 5 Sec Fist Against Chin is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the levator scapulae (neck). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category.

results.name: 90 to 90 Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with both legs bent at 90 degrees. Position one leg in front of your body with your thigh and shin at a 90-degree angle, and the other leg to the side with your thigh and shin at a 90-degree angle with foot extending backwards.
Lean lightly forward keeping your arms on the floor and holding the stretch for a few seconds.
Switch the position of your legs to perform the stretch on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your back straight as you lean forward to maximize the stretch and avoid straining your lower back.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch to help relax your muscles.
Perform the stretch slowly and avoid bouncing or jerking movements to reduce the risk of injury.
results.description: 90 to 90 Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Glutes.

results.name: Abdominal Stretch ( Version2 )
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and drawn towards your chest.
Place your hands on your knees keeping them set and lean your chest to your knees to stretch.
Hold the stretch in this position, allowing your back to round slightly and your head to relax forward.
After holding the stretch for the desired amount of time, release your arms and return to a neutral sitting position.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching them up towards your ears.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch to help relax your muscles.
Perform the stretch slowly and avoid any sudden movements to prevent strain.
results.description: Abdominal Stretch ( Version2 ) is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Abdominal Stretch
instructions: Sit on the floor with your knees bent and drawn towards your chest.
Wrap your arms around your knees, hugging them tightly.
Hold the stretch in this position, allowing your back to round slightly and your head to relax forward.
After holding the stretch for the desired amount of time, release your arms and return to a neutral sitting position.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching them up towards your ears.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch to help relax your muscles.
Perform the stretch slowly and avoid any sudden movements to prevent strain.
results.description: Abdominal Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Lower Back.

results.name: Above Head Chest Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your back straight. Raise your arms overhead and clasp your hands together with elbows bent.
Keeping your hands clasped, bring your elbows backward to stretch.
Hold the stretch in this position, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
After holding the stretch for the desired amount of time, return to the starting position.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching them up towards your ears.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch to help relax your muscles.
Maintain a straight back and engaged core to ensure proper form and maximize the stretch.
results.description: Above Head Chest Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Across Chest Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your back straight. Raise one arm to shoulder height and bring it across your chest.
Use your opposite hand to grasp your upper arm and gently pull it towards your chest, stretching your shoulder.
Hold the stretch in this position.
Release your arm and repeat the movement on the other side.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid hunching them up towards your ears.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch to help relax your muscles.
Maintain a straight back and avoid twisting your torso to ensure proper form.
results.description: Across Chest Shoulder Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Adductor Dynamic Stretch
instructions: Lie on your back on a mat with both legs extended upwards.
Open your legs wide apart, stretching your inner thighs.
Bring your legs back together to the starting position.
Continue the movement in a dynamic manner, opening and closing your legs.
tips: Keep your core engaged to maintain stability and control throughout the movement.
Perform the movement with controlled and smooth transitions to maximize the stretch and prevent injury.
Breathe steadily, exhaling as you open your legs and inhaling as you bring them back together.
results.description: Adductor Dynamic Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the adductors (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Quadriceps.
